root_idea.summary: The root centers on holding back, confinement, or being retained.
root_idea.development: This orientation appears in the retention of rain and urine, in bindings that hold a load in place, and in carrying or accumulating something behind oneself. The temporal branch conceptualizes a long period as an accumulation of years.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Presented under the normalized singular dictionary citation form حُقْب.
The Quranic plural أَحْقَاب is presented under its supported singular citation form حُقْب.

senses.definition: A long or extended period of time; in the plural, successive long periods or ages.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quran uses the singular in حُقُبًا for an extended span and the plural أَحْقَابًا for successive ages. Lexical reports differ over whether a ḥuqb has a fixed measure, so the Quranic usage does not require one exact number of years.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To suffer suppression or difficulty of urination; said especially of a camel whose urine is obstructed by pressure from the hind girth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a Form I intransitive use, with the obstruction associated with the حَقَب or hind girth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be held back, delayed, diminished, or impeded; of rain, to be withheld; of a mine, to cease yielding; of a gift or benefit, to become little or cease; and of an affair, to become disordered or obstructed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: These are extended or figurative uses applied to rain, years, mines, benefits, and affairs.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To gird a camel with a حَقَب, the hind girth or securing strap.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form IV; the object is the camel and its saddle equipment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make another person ride behind him on the same beast.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional causative riding construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To put, carry, or convey a bag or other thing behind the rider or behind a saddle; by extension, to make a person ride behind on the carried baggage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form VIII; the underlying image is of something secured or conveyed behind the rider.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take upon oneself or accumulate a burden, whether good or evil, and lay it up for the future; of sin, to incur or commit it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative Form VIII use based on carrying or collecting something behind oneself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A period or stretch of time of unspecified duration.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This feminine noun is explicitly related to حُقْب, but its duration is left undefined in the cited lexical account.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A camel’s hind girth, or a cord used to secure the saddle or a rear baggage receptacle to the animal’s belly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The strap lies near the animal’s flank and is used to prevent the saddle from shifting forward or causing injury.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In excellent she-camels, slender or small flanks with taut, firm skin, regarded as an approved quality.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical or descriptive use concerning the conformation of a camel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A woman’s waist ornament or ornamented band worn around the waist.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A named article of adornment, compared in the lexical account with a threaded ornament.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A thread or string tied around a child’s waist as protection against the evil eye.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct protective use of the waist-bound cord.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The whiteness appearing at the root of the nail.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical descriptive use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A bag, receptacle, or item of baggage carried behind the rider or attached to the rear of a saddle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word may denote travel provisions, goods, utensils, padding, or other material conveyed at the back of the saddle.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A thing one takes upon oneself or lays up for future consequences, figuratively conceived as baggage carried behind.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A tropical use illustrated with burdens of evil and the stored benefit of piety.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The hind parts or posteriors of a woman or man.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A bodily use derived from the rearward location associated with the baggage term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One afflicted with urinary difficulty or retention; of a person, one delayed in urination or suffering constipation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word is also applied to a camel whose urination is obstructed by pressure from the hind girth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A wild ass, especially one described as white on the belly or flanks or as slender in the flanks.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The cited lexical authorities differ over whether the name refers primarily to whiteness or to slenderness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A tall, slender isolated mountain or rocky hill whose middle or flanks are marked by whitish dust or mirage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A feminine descriptive form applied to a قارة or small isolated mountain; the precise account of the whiteness varies in the cited wording.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One made to ride behind another on the same beast.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive-participial use describing the rear rider.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Something bound upon a حَقِيبَة or upon rear saddle-bags.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive-participial use describing an object secured to the baggage behind the saddle.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The fox.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A lexicalized animal name explained by the whiteness of the fox’s belly.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who makes another person ride behind him on the same beast.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An active-participial use describing the person providing the rear ride.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who makes his religion follow that of others without evidence, proof, or considered judgment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use of the active participle, describing uncritical conformity in religious belief.

cautions: Lexical reports assign varying numerical measures to حُقْب; the Quranic contexts support an extended duration without requiring a single fixed measure.
A historical Lane citation is not used here as a modern verse location; the displayed Quran examples rely on the independently supplied QAC locations.
